column1: # Places added by hand to the place-name registry (gazetteer.py).
# For names missing from OpenStreetMap, or one of several with the same name
# that the traffic desk means. A name here replaces OpenStreetMap entries of
# the same name within 5 km and wins over other places with that name.
#   name  kind  lat  lon  county  note
# kind: landmark (a spot on a road, ±600 m), junction, roundabout, bridge,
#       rest_area, locality, village, ... (see KIND_RADIUS_M in gazetteer.py)
# county: county code, S = Värmlands län, T = Örebro län (see COUNTIES)
